note: Lucas County Board of Elections official summary reports for the May 4, 2010 primary and the November 2, 2010 general election contain no Toledo mayor contest. Toledo's mayoral contests fall in odd-numbered years (2013, 2017, 2021, 2025) plus a 2015 special, so no mayoral election occurred in 2010.

Lucas County Board of Elections official summary reports for the September 13, 2011 municipal primary and the November 8, 2011 general election list Maumee and Waterville city mayors and village mayors but no Toledo mayor contest. No mayoral election occurred in Toledo in 2011.
Lucas County Board of Elections official summary reports for the March 6, 2012 primary and the November 6, 2012 general election contain no Toledo mayor contest. No mayoral election occurred in 2012.

The county official canvass for the November 5, 2013 general election records a Toledo mayor contest between D. Michael Collins and Michael P. Bell. The September 10, 2013 primary was an earlier round. Winner and runner-up are in toledo_results.json.
Lucas County Board of Elections official summary reports for the May 6, 2014 primary and the November 4, 2014 general election contain no Toledo mayor contest. No mayoral election occurred in 2014.

The county official results for the November 3, 2015 general election record a seven-candidate Toledo City Mayor contest decided in one round. The September 15, 2015 primary summary lists no mayoral contest. This is outside the regular 2013 and 2017 cycle, so the file records it as a special election. The special label is inferred from that cycle. The county reports do not use the word special. Winner and runner-up are in toledo_results.json.

Lucas County Board of Elections official summary reports for the March 15, 2016 primary and the November 8, 2016 general election contain no Toledo mayor contest. The November 8, 2016 report is a scanned image read by OCR. No mayoral election occurred in 2016.

The county official results for the November 7, 2017 general election record a Toledo mayor contest between Wade Kapszukiewicz and Paula Hicks-Hudson. The September 12, 2017 primary was an earlier round. Winner and runner-up are in toledo_results.json.

Lucas County Board of Elections official summary reports for the May 8, 2018 primary and the November 6, 2018 general election contain no Toledo mayor contest. Both reports are scanned images read by OCR. No mayoral election occurred in 2018.

Lucas County Board of Elections official results for the November 5, 2019 general election and the certified September 2019 results list other city and village mayors but no Toledo mayor contest. The February 26, 2019 and May 7, 2019 special election reports (scanned) also show none. No mayoral election occurred in Toledo in 2019.

Lucas County Board of Elections official results summary reports for 2020, including the November 3, 2020 general election, contain no Toledo mayor contest. The March 2020 primary report was not opened. No mayoral election occurred in 2020.

The county official vote totals for the November 2, 2021 general election record a Toledo City Mayor contest between Wade Kapszukiewicz and Carty Finkbeiner. The September 14, 2021 primary was an earlier round. Winner and runner-up are in toledo_results.json.
Lucas County Board of Elections official results for the May and August 2022 primaries and the November 2022 general election contain no Toledo mayor contest. No mayoral election occurred in 2022.

Lucas County Board of Elections official results for the May 2, 2023 special election, the September 12, 2023 primary, the October 3, 2023 primary and the November 2023 general election contain no Toledo mayor contest. No mayoral election occurred in 2023.
